verdict.rationale: Founder Law's pricing page explicitly includes "Full Legal Defense For Any Potential RFE and NOID," and its About page says packages cover "any RFE responses." RFE/NOID response work is therefore a documented, included service, not limited to clean first filings. The documentation is still thin: it is a line-item claim with no description of how responses are handled. missing for 10: description of the RFE/NOID response process, clarity on which packages include it, case examples or independent/client corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings
